In this video, we explore the different Spark APIs that developers use to write code and process big data. From low-level APIs to modern structured APIs, you’ll learn how Spark provides multiple ways to interact with data.
All code and data files are available on the below path:
What you’ll learn:
Low-level APIs: RDDs (Resilient Distributed Datasets) & Distributed Variables
Structured APIs: DataFrames, Datasets, and Spark SQL
Why DataFrames & SQL are most commonly used today
High-level Spark libraries: Structured Streaming, MLlib, GraphX, and more
